question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A book that contains information on various subjects
solution:
The correct answer is **Encyclopedia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is Encyclopedia.
 
• An encyclopedia (विश्वकोश, विद्यावली, सारसंग्रह) means a book or series of books that provide knowledge about a variety of themes or aspects of a single subject and is normally organised alphabetically.
 
• Thus the correct answer is Encyclopedia.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Encyclopaedia**, sometimes spelt encyclopaedia, is a reference work that offers information on all disciplines of knowledge or treats a certain branch of knowledge in depth.

 
 
• 
 
**Example-* ****It is not uncommon for its entries to be five to ten times the length of other encyclopedias.*

 
 
• 
 
*Besides Wikipedia, there are dozens of other free online encyclopedias.*

 
 
 
 
• 
 
***​*****Manuscript: **a book, document, or piece of music written by hand rather than typed or printed (हस्तलिपि, हाथ से लिखी हुई पुस्तक)

 
 
• 
 
**Thesaurus**: a book of words or of information about a particular field or set of concepts (विद्या भंडार,शब्दकोश)

 
 
• 
 
**Dictionary**: a reference book listing alphabetically terms or names along with discussion of their meanings and applications (शब्दकोश)
